How Much Does a 2023 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing Cost After 24,254 Miles?
11 photos
Photo: Instagram | jesus.spec
Does the rather aging Cadillac CT5 still keep you up at night? Well, we won’t blame you if it does, because this thing looks a lot better than most of the premium mid-size models on sale today.
Things get a lot more exciting if you consider sprucing up your life with the Blackwing model, because this one is a veritable BMW M5 fighter. Everyone and their pet knows that it features an LT4 V8 engine. The supercharged mill has a 6.2-liter displacement, and pumps out no less than 668 brake horsepower (498 kW/678 ps) and 659 lb-ft (893 Nm) of torque.
That’s without anyone tampering with its engine, which can be paired either with a six-speed manual transmission or an available ten-speed automatic unit. Cadillac’s CT5-V Blackwing takes just 3.4 seconds to sprint from 0 to 60 mph (0 to 97 kph), and that’s actually quicker than the iconic Ferrari Enzo, and flat-out, it will do over 200 mph or 322+ kph.
Pictured in the gallery is a 2023 model year that features the stick shift. The business super sedan in question has a white look, some glossy black details, and rides on dark gray wheels. It also sports tinted windows, and the interior mixes white and black leather upholstery, sprinkled with red piping, some red stitching, red seatbelts, black pillars, and a black headliner, among other things.
Photo: Instagram | jesus.spec Some carbon fiber trim is also on deck here, there is a red 12 o’clock marker on the steering wheel, and as we told you above, it is a stick shift machine . The pictures released by the selling dealer do not allow us to see whether there is any wear on the driver’s seat, but there should be some, given that this is a 2023 model year car, which had 25,254 miles (40,642 km) under its belt at the time of cataloging.
Now, just because it is a used example does not mean that it will go easy on your wallet, as the average Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing that hits the used car market in the United States of America tends to sell from roughly $80,000 to over $125,000. It all depends on the model year, mileage, options, overall conditions, and so on. The 2026 MY starts at $98,900 (MSRP), and in case you forgot, the CT5 production is ending at the end of 2026.
But how much do you think this 2023 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing costs? Unless you said $94,995, then you are wrong, because this was the asking price at the time of writing. The car in question is advertised on social media by @jesus.spec, which invites interested parties to reach out to them for more information. So, could this be your next used cool ride?
